spans.s: --a deity on the यन्त्र of विशुक्र. Br. IV. २७. ३८. [page२-238+ २५]
--a region of पाताल, of red soil. Vi.
--(Nitundakas-वि। प्।); a class of पिशाचस् with bulging bellies, long noses, hanging abdomen, short stature and so on; eaters of तिल। Br.
--one of the fifteen अक्षरदेवीस्; Her city was नित्यक्लिन्नापुरी. Br. IV. १९. ५७; ३१. २४; ३७. ३३.
--(श्राद्धम्) nothing of अर्घ्य and आवा- हनम्। M. १६. 5.

--the policy taught by शुक्र to the Asuras and sought by him from महेश्वर;
1: M. ४७. ७४, ७५; वा. ९७. १०५.
according to बृहस्पति, it commences with साम for a conquering monarch; other अन्गस् are bheda, दान, and दण्ड; but the application depends on the place, time and resources of the enemy; in the case of Asuras only दण्ड can be recommended.
2: M. १४८. ६५-71.
